2610.09795.title: MIRROR: From Imitation to Internalization in LLM Personalization
2610.09795.paper_summary: The demand for personalized LLMs is shifting from style imitation toward content quality. We investigate whether self-distillation can bridge this gap in existing fine-tuning paradigm. To address this limitation, we introduce MIRROR(Meta- personalization by Internalizing Reference-Revealed On-policy Reflections), a novel self-distillation framework that shifts LLM personalization from imitation toward preference internalization. First, we replace reference-token imitation with reference-revealed on-policy self-distillation, aligning the model's next-token distributions along its own generation trajectories with those of its reference-conditioned self, thereby internalizing user preferences rather than reproducing reference wording.Second, we introduce MIRROR-F, a focal plug-in that augments on-policy distributional alignment with selective supervision over informative reference tokens, thereby strengthening content generation while preserving user-specific expression. Across three personalized generation benchmarks, two model scales, and complementary reference-based and LLM-based evaluations, MIRROR and MIRROR-F achieve leading overall personalization performance and superior text quality, while exhibiting less catastrophic forgetting than SFT-based baselines on three unseen personalized generation tasks. The gains are consistent across model scales and application scenarios, translating to improved performance in LLM personalization tasks.
2610.09795.paper_summary_zh: 個性化 LLM 的需求正從風格模仿轉向內容質量。我們探討自我蒸餾是否能彌補現有微調範式中的這一差距。為了解決這一限制，我們引入了 MIRROR（通過內化參考揭示的政策反思進行元個性化），這是一個新穎的自我蒸餾框架，將 LLM 的個性化從模仿轉向偏好內化。首先，我們用參考揭示的政策自我蒸餾取代了參考標記模仿，將模型的下一個標記分佈與其參考條件自我的生成軌跡對齊，從而內化用戶偏好，而不是重複參考措辭。其次，我們引入了 MIRROR-F，一個焦點插件，通過對信息參考標記的選擇性監督來增強政策分佈對齊，從而加強內容生成，同時保留用戶特定的表達。在三個個性化生成基準、兩個模型規模以及互補的基於參考和基於 LLM 的評估中，MIRROR 和 MIRROR-F 在整體個性化性能和文本質量上達到了領先的表現，同時在三個未見的個性化生成任務中表現出比基於 SFT 的基線更少的災難性遺忘。這些增益在模型規模和應用場景中是一致的，轉化為 LLM 個性化任務中性能的提升。
